Checkpoint 04 · Filename lab

Make the Name Carry Clues

A useful filename tells you what the file is before you open it. Improve each example, then infer the shared rules.

Repair the mystery filenames

Required
image1.jpg
work final FINAL 2.html
thing.pdf
Meaningful wordsDescribe the actual content.
Capital lettersMake each word easy to spot.
Keep the extension.html, .jpg and .pdf identify the file type.

Why not dates alone?

A name such as 03-09-26 tells you when, but not what. Useful filenames combine content clues with a date only when the date adds meaning.

Trailblazer challenge

Stretch

A pupil has three files called Assessment.html. Write a filename system that would let them identify the subject, unit and newest version without opening each file.

Checkpoint 05 · Retrieval mission

Download, Rename, Find

This is the real test: can you move a file through the route and retrieve the exact copy without guessing?

Your mission route

Required
Download the mission noteUse the button. Your browser may ask where to save it.
Move it to your Unit 1 folderUse File Explorer and the folder path you created.
Rename it exactlyUnit1MissionNote.txt — capitals mark the words; the .txt extension stays.
Close and retrieve itNavigate from My Documents rather than using Recent files.
Upload it belowThe workbook checks both its name and its hidden mission phrase.
Do not use Search yetA navigator should understand the route. Searching is useful later, but it can hide a poor folder system.

Explorer field guide

Key terms

FileA named item that stores information, such as a document, image or HTML workbook.
FolderA container used to group related files and other folders.
File pathThe ordered route through folders to reach a particular file.
File extensionThe ending, such as .html, .jpg or .pdf, that identifies a file type.
Local storageFiles stored in your school computer account area, such as My Documents.
Cloud storageFiles stored online and reached through an account, such as Google Drive.
DownloadCopy a file from an online service to your device or school file area.
UploadSend a file from your device or school file area to an online service.
